about: An enum value as a <param> crosses as the name its enum document declares for it: the machine sends itself `view.shown` with the value of a variable, of a field of a record variable and of a conditional, and reads the layout back through the schema, so what arrives is what the enum variable held. `agenda_list` is spelled with an underscore: the wire carries the name the document wrote, not an identifier a backend made of it. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: the variable and the record start at the values the document gives them
a conditional of two values of the enum: a week is sent as a day
a variable: the week it holds
the variable changes to a variant spelled with an underscore
the underscore name crosses as written
a field of a record variable: the day it holds
the conditional keeps the variable when it is no week
